cases.name: Strict configuration
cases.oracle: Unknown fields, wrong modes, symlink/parent escapes, changed pins and partial writes fail before effects; no CWD authority.

cases.name: Trusted establishment
cases.oracle: Actual verified provider binding plus pre-enrolled host session yields one opaque capability; arbitrary principal/logical-session input and absent grants fail.

cases.name: Resume and revocation
cases.oracle: One-use trusted resume rotates capability; stale/replayed/cross-scope refs and old/revoked capability fail.

cases.name: Session isolation
cases.oracle: Two accounts/projects/logical sessions see only own tasks through both CLI and MCP, including guessed IDs and direct service calls.

cases.name: Exact prose pipeline
cases.oracle: Actual frozen skill prepare/packet/review/finalize executes; proper kind/ref/style and exact rendered text/metadata bind approval before task submission.

cases.name: Writing bypass
cases.oracle: Missing/stale/changed/fake approval, wrong kind, package mutation, code literal/title/body change and metadata reuse reject.

cases.name: Semantic review honesty
cases.oracle: Model self-review may be honest self-review; injected independent/human reviewer identity, malformed scores and fabricated receipt files cannot publish.

cases.name: Writing dependencies
cases.oracle: Unavailable Python/skill/ref/style or subprocess failure is an explicit refusal with retained attempt history, not skipped approval.

cases.name: Version update
cases.oracle: Old receipt remains historical; new policy/package requires audit/new matching approval and cannot silently relabel versions.

cases.name: Progress prose
cases.oracle: Published progress requires actual issue-type/style approval; internal checkpoint data is not automatically a published comment.

cases.name: Intake and immediate sync
cases.oracle: Reviewed local intake creates existing durable intent, invokes provider adapter immediately and confirms exact Backlog; uncertainty stays pending.

cases.name: No unmanaged state writes
cases.oracle: No raw status/evidence/principal issuer tool exists; each action maps through guarded core or trusted adapter.

cases.name: Delegated decision limits
cases.oracle: Grant scopes/action/expiry/revision constrain agent decisions; no agent grant can mint human acceptance or clear a human hold.

cases.name: Human review proof
cases.oracle: Every review target remains supported through real observed human proof and destination evidence; caller human=true or prose approval is insufficient.

cases.name: Lifecycle guards
cases.oracle: Delivered reopen, skipped Backlog/Todo, missing resource/startup/verification, Part-of completion and unknown states refuse through core.

cases.name: Idempotency and stale input
cases.oracle: Same op replay is idempotent; changed reuse and stale task/decision versions fail with no partial side effects.

cases.name: Worker composition
cases.oracle: Service delegates real start/admit/execute to runtime and immediate provider confirmer; missing accounting/command authority refuses before a model launch.

cases.name: Sync uncertainty
cases.oracle: HTTP errors, ambiguous mutation, unavailable ingress and unknown runtime remain typed non-success; no false Running/Done.

cases.name: Lead receipts
cases.oracle: Event read/cursor advance, arbitrary ack text, forged/wrong-session/stage-skipping proof cannot become actual AI/public acknowledgement.

cases.name: CLI entry point
cases.oracle: Real source and installed wheel commands return correct JSON/exit classes with no secrets; malformed/bounded input and unknown action reject.

cases.name: Scoped presentation
cases.oracle: Every state has a distinct symbol/text, ANSI disabled under no-color/JSON, pending/unknown separated from issue delivery state.

cases.name: MCP stdio
cases.oracle: Actual separate SDK client/server process negotiates, lists frozen tools/schemas, calls scoped operations and shuts down; stdout contains only protocol.

cases.name: MCP adversarial input
cases.oracle: Unknown method/tool/extra key, malformed/wrong/oversized arguments, concurrent calls and canceled requests fail without authority or partial writes.

cases.name: Transport parity
cases.oracle: CLI and MCP dispatch the same service operations and produce equivalent domain facts/error categories.

cases.name: Recovery and schema
cases.oracle: Application/writing/authority receipts survive restart, changed schema refuses, pending stages remain pending and failed attempts remain visible.

cases.name: Architecture
cases.oracle: Focused modules have directional imports; no legacy monolith, adapter table writes to core stores, second policy table or public catch-all issuer.

cases.name: Composition fixture
cases.oracle: Use real core and reviewed provider/runtime public composition with loopback/owned fixtures; assert lifecycle facts before any reconciliation timer.

cases.name: Live host plan
cases.oracle: Frozen actual tool-enabled host plan identifies exact package/config/session/model trace/cost/teardown, remains unrun until lead review and missing prerequisites resolved.

mechanical_scope: Actual local subprocess CLI/stdio MCP, actual pinned Technical Writer validator, real core and trusted isolated adapter fixtures. No live models/provider or normal config effects.
behavioral_scope: Separate later fresh actual Claude Code and Codex traces; SDK/mechanical results do not establish AI behavior.
review_addendum: Pending intake and uncertain task reads remain readable; tests refuse premature effect or success claims, not legitimate task_show.
Notification delivery/AI/public stages may be observed and recorded incrementally in order; earlier receipts do not wait for future ones.
Code proves actual packet delivery/hash matching; AI reading/understanding remains separate fresh behavior evidence.
Reference policy binds all six issue contracts and referenced guidance; actual kind/purpose and exact prose/metadata remain receipt-bound, and progress approval cannot become task approval.
Trusted host enrollment/human observation/accounted launch are explicit required ports, never caller-minted identities or fabricated readiness.
Progress approval uses fixed TaskProse metadata and a task/scope/current-task-prose bound verifier view; Core TaskApprovals rejects progress-purpose refs. Add task_id to writing_prepare for progress.
Add staged external-prose read/accept operations through real writer and fresh provider readback, with no model-selected readback context.

Observed human actions atomically record their new core decision revision before derived action proof; grants cannot relabel an agent as human. Scope revision additionally binds proposed prose digest.
Persist public operation fingerprint and stable proof references before core effects; retries after reply loss do not mint a different core request or reapply changed inputs.
